-- WindLeaves.lua  (Server Script)
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- CONFIG
local treePath = script.Parent               -- set this to workspace.YourTreeModel if script not parented to the tree
local leavesFolderName = "Leaves"            -- folder name under treePath
local windStrength = 4                  -- base angle multiplier (tweak)
local windSpeed = 1.0                        -- speed multiplier (tweak)
local enforceAnchored = true                 -- set true to auto Anchor leaves (recommended)
local debugEnabled = true

-- Helper debug
local function debug(...)
	if debugEnabled then
		print("[WindLeaves]", ...)
	end
end

-- Find Leaves folder
local function findLeavesFolder()
	if not treePath then return nil end
	local folder = treePath:FindFirstChild(leavesFolderName)
	if folder and folder:IsA("Folder") then
		return folder
	end
	-- fallback: try to find any descendant folder named Leaves
	for _, v in pairs(treePath:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == leavesFolderName and v:IsA("Folder") then
			return v
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local LeavesFolder = findLeavesFolder()
if not LeavesFolder then
	debug("ERROR: Leaves folder not found under", treePath:GetFullName())
	return
end
debug("Found Leaves folder at", LeavesFolder:GetFullName())

-- Table to hold parts and their originals + random offset
local leafData = {}

local function addLeaf(part)
	if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	if leafData[part] then return end
	leafData[part] = {
		orig = part.CFrame,
		offset = math.random() * 1000,    -- unique time offset so leaves don't move perfectly in sync
	}
	if enforceAnchored then
		part.Anchored = true
	end
	debug("Added leaf:", part:GetFullName())
end

local function removeLeaf(part)
	if leafData[part] then
		leafData[part] = nil
		debug("Removed leaf:", part:GetFullName())
	end
end

-- Initialize existing children
for _, child in ipairs(LeavesFolder:GetChildren()) do
	addLeaf(child)
end

-- React to runtime changes
LeavesFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	-- wait a short tick in case child is a Model with parts inside
	task.wait(0.01)
	-- if child is a folder/model, add parts inside
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		addLeaf(child)
	else
		for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				addLeaf(desc)
			end
		end
	end
end)

LeavesFolder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
	-- remove whichever parts belonged to that child (or the child itself)
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		removeLeaf(child)
	else
		for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				removeLeaf(desc)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Also remove when parts are destroyed
game:GetService("Workspace").DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc and desc:IsA("BasePart") and leafData[desc] then
		leafData[desc] = nil
		debug("Leaf destroyed:", desc:GetFullName())
	end
end)

-- Main update loop (Heartbeat for smooth motion)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local t = tick() * windSpeed
	for part, info in pairs(leafData) do
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			leafData[part] = nil
		else
			-- compute small rotations based on noise / trig
			local clock = t + info.offset
			-- small independent axes
			local rx = math.rad(math.cos(clock) * windStrength)
			local ry = math.rad(math.sin(clock * 0.9) * windStrength * 0.6)
			local rz = math.rad(math.cos(clock * 1.1) * windStrength * 0.5)
			part.CFrame = info.orig * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
		end
	end
end)

debug("WindLeaves script started. Leaf count:", (function() local c=0; for _ in pairs(leafData) do c=c+1 end; return c end)())

-- A smooth, floating pet that follows about five studs behind each player.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local template = workspace:WaitForChild("Float Brick", 20)
if not template or not template:IsA("BasePart") then
	warn("[Untitled Slayers] Workspace.Float Brick was not found.")
	return
end
template.Anchored = true
template.CanCollide = false
template.Parent = ServerStorage

local active = {}
local connections = {}

local function clearBrick(player)
	local state = active[player]
	if state then
		state.brick:Destroy()
		active[player] = nil
	end
end

local function setupCharacter(player, character)
	clearBrick(player)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not root or not character.Parent then return end

	local brick = template:Clone()
	brick.Name = "Float Brick"
	brick.Anchored = true
	brick.CanCollide = false
	brick.CanTouch = false
	brick.CanQuery = false
	brick.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 5)
	brick.Parent = workspace
	active[player] = {brick = brick, root = root, elapsed = 0}
end

local function addPlayer(player)
	local added = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		setupCharacter(player, character)
	end)
	local removing = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		clearBrick(player)
	end)
	connections[player] = {added, removing}
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(setupCharacter, player, player.Character)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(addPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	clearBrick(player)
	for _, connection in connections[player] or {} do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	connections[player] = nil
end)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	addPlayer(player)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for player, state in pairs(active) do
		local root, brick = state.root, state.brick
		if root.Parent and brick.Parent and player.Character == root.Parent then
			state.elapsed += dt
			local bob = math.sin(state.elapsed * 2.6) * 0.35
			local target = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5 + bob, 5)
			local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-7 * dt)
			brick.CFrame = brick.CFrame:Lerp(target, alpha)
		end
	end
end)

-- Temporary session-only currency values for the existing MainUI scripts.
-- Replace with your persistent currency system when it is ready.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function setup(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		stats.Parent = player
	end

	for _, name in {"Coins", "Gems"} do
		if not stats:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("IntValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Value = 0
			value.Parent = stats
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	setup(player)
end

-- CoinsLabel (LocalScript) > TextLabel
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player      = Players.LocalPlayer
local coinsLabel  = script.Parent

-- ─── Format number with commas ────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function formatCoins(n)
	local str     = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local result  = ""
	local count   = 0

	for i = #str, 1, -1 do
		if count > 0 and count % 3 == 0 then
			result = "," .. result
		end
		result = str:sub(i, i) .. result
		count += 1
	end

	return result .. "$"
end

-- ─── Update label ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function updateLabel(coins)
	coinsLabel.Text = formatCoins(coins)
end

-- ─── Hook into leaderstats ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function setupCoins()
	local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
	local coins       = leaderstats:WaitForChild("Coins")

	updateLabel(coins.Value)

	coins:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		updateLabel(coins.Value)
	end)
end

setupCoins()
